units: Blender world; multiply XY by8 for Yard
space: Each polygon is relative to route/turn start root, already rotated into its cardinal facing

derivation.selection: body base vertices with rest z<.16 and rigid paw group weight>.995; same indices in evaluated body mesh
derivation.method: Convex hull of every evaluated lower sole vertex, rotated by authored paw facing, translated by authored paw anchor. Independent footprints retained for every unique planted support; endpoint included.
derivation.whyReusable: Existing real-skin audit verifies fixed planted rigid sole points over every authored turn pose; maximum drift8.63367673e-7 world. Grounded pawUp is vertical and pawForward horizontal in all used sources.
derivation.coverage: All rendered walk table contacts plus each canonical endpoint; all authored20fps turn contacts. Grounded supports remain fixed between liftoff/landing events. Does not cover airborne paws or whole-body obstacle bounds.
derivation.maskRule: Do not merge footprints into one actor AABB. Test each polygon against meadow row strips and separate obstacle footprints; preserve the existing coarse3.44yard root gate and full visible turn actor bounds. Source isYardPointInPlayzone uses round(y/2), so row r spans [2r-1,2r+1), clamped to0..100. Existing core floor/ceil rectangle-mask padding remains an additional conservative policy; do not silently replace that policy.
derivation.walkComposition: For an N-stride phase0 leg, translate this one-stride coverage by each k*rootDelta, k=0..N-1. For phase.5 departure use runways first, then full strides.
